mapper.insert: insert into media_event (event_type, target_type, target_key, owner_key, value_num, progress, ip, user_agent, create_time) values (#{eventType}, #{targetType}, #{targetKey}, #{ownerKey,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{valueNum}, #{progress}, #{ip,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{userAgent,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, now())

insert into media_stats_daily (stat_date, event_type, target_type, target_key, cnt, value_sum) values (curdate(), #{eventType}, #{targetType}, #{targetKey}, 1, #{valueNum}) on duplicate key update cnt = cnt + 1, value_sum = value_sum + values(value_sum)
